body:
## Summary
- Replace the soft mint/sage theme with a competitive arena palette: volt win (`#c8ff2e`), cyan signal, cobalt rival, amber cue, KO red.
- Refresh lobby hero, category chips, board accents, and all game cover gradients to match.
- Keep cool ice hovers instead of cream sand so the UI reads like an online games portal.

## Test plan
- [ ] `bun start` or `bun start:docker`, open the lobby — hero should be navy→cyan with volt CTA
- [ ] Scan game covers — saturated, distinct per title (not soft green)
- [ ] Win a match — status pill / outcome accents use volt, not mint green
- [ ] Check mobile lobby categories and play board contrast


Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)
title: Competitive color palette for the online game lobby
